species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 50°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 20–64 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 95 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 50°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 26–30 ft deep, mostly on drop-offs.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 95 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 50°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 16–34 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 95 ft, so fish stay above it.
Southwest wind at 18 mph pushes bait onto the northeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
